findings.claim_text: On August 18, 2026, Marvell issued Google LLC a warrant to purchase up to 58,970,907 shares at $206.58, exercisable until August 18, 2033.
Full vesting of the performance warrant requires $120 billion of cumulative Qualifying Revenue (240 x $500M) — this is a vesting cap, not a purchase commitment or revenue forecast.
Marvell shares rose about 10% on August 19, 2026 following the 8-K disclosure while Broadcom fell about 5%.
